record.paper_title: On the Number and the Geometry of Hyperbolic Knots and Links with a Common Cyclic Branched Covering: Known Results and Open Problems
record.original_question: Let M be a hyperbolic 3-manifold that is a p-fold cyclic branched covering of a knot in S^3. Which non-solvable finite groups can occur as the isometry group of M?

evidence.quote: Problem 2.4: What are the possible non-solvable isometry groups of an hyperbolic 3-manifold M which is a p-fold cyclic branched covering of a knot in S^3?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let $K\subset S^3$ be a knot whose $p$-fold cyclic branched covering $M\to S^3$ (branched along $K$, with $p\ge 2$ a prime) yields a hyperbolic 3-manifold $M$. By Mostow rigidity, the group $\mathrm{Isom}(M)$ of isometries of $M$ is finite. Determine which non-solvable finite groups can arise as $\mathrm{Isom}(M)$ for some such pair $(K,p)$. Equivalently, classify the isomorphism types of non-solvable finite groups that occur as the full isometry group of a hyperbolic 3-manifold realized as a $p$-fold cyclic branched covering of a knot in $S^3$.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature on cyclic branched coverings of hyperbolic knots (Mecchia–Reni, Boileau–Paoluzzi–Zimmermann, and related works) treats the solvable case in detail and reduces the non-solvable case to a list of candidate quotients (non-solvable subgroups of GL(4,2) ≅ A_8), but does not provide a complete classification of the non-solvable isometry groups that occur. No source found announces a full resolution, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Finite groups acting on 3-manifolds and cyclic branched coverings
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses non-solvable subgroups of GL(4,2)≅A_8 as candidates for quotients arising from isometry groups of cyclic branched covers of knots.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial structural results are available in the non-solvable case.

status_evidence.title: Isometry Groups of Hyperbolic Three-Manifolds which are Cyclic Branched Coverings
status_evidence.snippet: Studies isometry groups of hyperbolic 3-manifolds arising as cyclic branched coverings of knots.
status_evidence.claim: Establishes structural results but does not classify all non-solvable possibilities.

status_evidence.title: Hyperbolic knots and cyclic branched covers
status_evidence.snippet: Survey discussing solvable and non-solvable cases of isometry groups of cyclic branched covers.
status_evidence.claim: The non-solvable case remains only partially understood.
